analyst.summary: Eris Lifesciences has been expanding aggressively into the diabetes/insulin market through the acquisition of Biocon Biologics' India branded-formulation business, and headline quarterly profit more than tripled year-on-year. However, a large one-off tax credit accounts for a substantial share of that profit increase, and underlying sales growth was modest and declined sequentially -- so the headline number overstates the pace of real operating improvement. Debt has also risen to fund the acquisition. We rate this a Hold: a sound long-term strategic move, but the current quarter's reported profit growth is not a reliable run-rate.
